output.reason: [ev-fbe2aedc4ddc] says the redirect-back-to-backend behaviour only happens when Local Redirect Policy is enabled with socket-based load-balancing, and that setting `skipRedirectFromBackend: true` overrides it. The proposed exposure checks only that a CiliumLocalRedirectPolicy exists without the field. It ignores the socket-based load-balancing condition, so it also flags clusters that do not use socket-based load-balancing and are not exposed. The evidence does not name the configuration key that enables socket-based load-balancing, so that part has to be an undecidable operand. The new field is confirmed in the 1.16 CRD schema [ev-313ddc646740, ev-b059d552dcc2]. Policies that set `skipRedirectFromBackend: true` are shielded, so they belong in the overlap.

correction.statement: Environments are exposed when they have a cilium.io/v2 CiliumLocalRedirectPolicy without spec.skipRedirectFromBackend set and socket-based load-balancing is enabled. In that case, traffic from the policy-selected node-local backends to the policy's frontend is now redirected back to the node-local backends by default. Policies that set skipRedirectFromBackend to true are shielded.

of.needed: whether socket-based load-balancing is enabled together with Local Redirect Policy (the evidence does not name the configuration key)
